mapper.sql: select category_id, category_type, parent_id, category_code, category_name, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from lf_category
mapper.insert: insert into lf_category ( category_type, parent_id, category_code, category_name, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) values ( #{categoryType}, #{parentId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), '0' )
mapper.update:
update lf_category
category_type = #{categoryType}, parent_id = #{parentId}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, category_name = #{categoryName}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'
